sourceProfile.shape_origin: declared example; statically inferred, not observed
sourceProfile.drawing_scope: One conditional MaskedLinear; get_mask supplies construction provenance, not a learned attention mask.

sourceFacts: Main and condition projections have distinct weights; only the main weight is masked.
Source constructor accepts bias but does not pass it to the main Linear, which retains its default bias.
get_mask compares output and input degrees; a strict autoregressive output mask requires the output degree offset.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
